changes.behavior: Installed form source IDs now return Hydro immunity through the existing shared hasElementImmunity gate. Native direct skills, fields and final raw elemental/reaction packets preserve HP and the crab shield. Physical and other-element damage is unaffected.

The existing Pyro/armor-break 4-hit objective is shared by direct and delayed packets. An eligible damage call advances exactly one hit and returns before normal HP subtraction; raw applyDamage also goes through the count path. The one-HP core cannot be killed by an ordinary raw packet. Zero/rounded-zero or ineligible packets do not advance. The fourth hit clears the core once. Existing claymore Cryo attacks, revival deadline, single-revival rule, save count and victory payout are preserved.

Zero/rounded-zero, invalid-element and enemy self-packets cannot reduce the core to0 or advance

Xiangling summons have two actual once-per-round ticks; repeated same-round calls and expired summon do not add hits

Four Hypostasis bodies keep own-element immunity; Anemo raw core, Electro prisms and Geo pillars work as before
Eight other-element water-form defeats still settle victory

fixturePolicy: Native actors and legal cards; Lv60/phase, owned four-member party, +6 legal equipment, talent8 are fixtures. Oversized packets are declared boundary setup; typed reaction probes supplement real skills.

references.fact: Hydro Mimics are immune to Hydro; no original innate-resistance numbers are added in this patch.
Hypostasis bodies are immune to their own element. The authored CRPG four Pyro/armor-break hit conversion remains the current rule rather than adding the original Frostfruit mechanic.
